registered_by: claude-fable-5-1 (configured identifier; serving model may differ)
scoring_rule: Brier score = mean((p - outcome)^2) over resolved predictions; outcome = 1 if the confirmation condition is met at the resolution date, 0 if the falsification condition is met; unresolved predictions are excluded and counted separately. The stated probability is the registrant's probability that the CONFIRMATION condition holds.
notes: All predictions phrased so that confirmation and falsification are decidable from public sources at the resolution date. Probabilities in the 0.3-0.7 band are required for at least five items (anti-gaming rule, PROTOCOL.md section 7.7). 'Realised' losses mean funds actually extracted and not returned or reversed, as reported in official post-mortems or DefiLlama 'returnedFunds'-adjusted figures; notional mints do not count.

predictions.statement: No exploit of a PRE-EXISTING (not attacker-created) sole-required-DVN LayerZero configuration protecting a reservoir > $10M occurs between 2026-10-01 and 2027-03-31.
predictions.confirmed_if: no such exploit is publicly documented

predictions.statement: Cross-chain verification CODE defects (M-02) exceed attestation-CONFIGURATION failures (M-01) in realised losses for 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31.
predictions.confirmed_if: sum of realised M-02 losses > sum of realised M-01 losses, classifying each bridge incident by its post-mortem

predictions.statement: Chain- or protocol-level halt/rollback/freeze is used in >= 3 incidents with >= $5M at stake between 2026-10-01 and 2027-03-31, and at least one such use is contested in governance or in court.

At least one further malicious-participant threshold-signature attack (a bonded/registered signer extracting key material or biasing key generation through protocol interaction) on a production network occurs between 2026-10-01 and 2027-09-30.
